quarterly_data.signal: Sanofi discontinued amlitelimab in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (July 24, 2026) as part of its pipeline strategic assessment: although the ESTUARY phase 3 long-term extension showed long-term maintenance of clinical response without relapse, the company concluded amlitelimab would not represent a meaningful improvement to the standard of care, and ongoing AD studies will be wound down. Sanofi is not amending its full-year 2026 guidance; the amlitelimab phase 2 study in celiac disease is ongoing, with a readout expected in the second half of 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 guidance unchanged; celiac phase 2 readout expected in the second half of 2026
